identity.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2026?

frozen_rule_facts.qualifying_event: OpenAI or its official representative announces OpenAI has solved a named qualifying problem during the interval beginning at market creation and ending 2026-12-31 23:59 ET (2027-01-01T04:59Z). Partial results/progress do not qualify. Navier-Stokes is expressly excluded. Primary source OpenAI/representatives; consensus credible reporting may also be used; Clay confirmation is not required.

dated_primary_facts.source: OpenAI, On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
dated_primary_facts.fact: OpenAI publicly claimed an internal-system solution to Navier–Stokes. Contract expressly excludes Navier–Stokes; page predates market creation (Sep9). Existing record is selected browser excerpt; direct GET had returned 403.

dated_primary_facts.source: OpenAI, Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
dated_primary_facts.fact: OpenAI said model resolved >100 open problems “in addition to” Navier–Stokes, without naming them in captured excerpt; unnamed results do not identify a listed problem. Existing selected browser excerpt; direct GET 403.

dated_primary_facts.source: OpenAI, Sharing AI progress in mathematics
dated_primary_facts.fact: OpenAI announced broad mathematical results from an internal frontier model and linked openai/math; Oct15 update describes Simons program/funding, not a named math result. Browser-read page; direct GET Oct19 returned 403.

dated_primary_facts.source: OpenAI-linked public GitHub repository openai/math, CONTENTS.md and history.md
dated_primary_facts.fact: OpenAI-linked repo reports 719 manuscripts/372 families and varying verification status. Catalog examples: quasi-RH zero-free half-plane (not full RH); two-primary BSD only Selmer-corank≤1; rational Hodge for CM abelian varieties and other restricted classes. Literal search found no “P versus NP” or “Yang-Mills” string, not exhaustive proof of absence.
Repository history reports sign-error withdrawal of three papers, including “rational Hodge conjecture for products of K3 surfaces”; distinct from CM-abelian paper.
Clay page lists these problems in unsolved section; context only because contract needs no Clay confirmation.

limits: This packet records sources and wording, not a settlement classification or probability.
